items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We had a boy named John Carter on the piano. In that band, we had John Carter on the piano

ctx.x: And we rehearsed that thing, and we rehearsed that thing, and I told Otis, 'Otis, you take it home with you. I said, 'You go to bed with it, get up with it. You can play it, I know you can play it.' Otis got so he could play that song. We changed pianos. We had a boy named John Carter on the piano. In that band, we had John Carter on the piano, we had Bill Martin on trumpet, on the bass -- who did we have on bass?
I know you had some Spanish boy playing trombone, married Hortense's sister.
